title: Executive Assistant (Operations | Real Estate | Night Shift)
description:
AP Required to Apply: 15+ (the more points you have, the more serious we know you are. Anything less than 15 AP will be archived immediately and not looked at)



This is not a traditional Executive Assistant role.



This is a high leverage role supporting a fast-moving real estate CEO who values precision, ownership, and speed.



If you need hand-holding, constant reassurance, or loose expectations—this is not for you.



This role is best suited for someone who prefers structure, ownership, and high standards over comfort or flexibility.



If you take pride in anticipating needs, protecting time, and executing cleanly—keep reading.



-



Location: Remote / Virtual



Schedule (CST): Monday–Friday, starting at 8:30 AM CST with a 1-hour unpaid break. This role also requires occasional after-hours or weekend responsiveness for guest and resident matters, which can be managed remotely via phone through the apps and Google Voice 



Compensation: $1,800/USD per month + (based on experience and performance)



Type: Full-Time Salary includes 13th month pay (prorated) 



-



About ZenHomes



ZenHomes is a lean, high-performing real estate company based in Texas. We acquire off-market properties, manage rentals, and operate with clarity, accountability, and systems.



We run a small, trusted team across the U.S. and the Philippines. We don’t do busywork. We don’t micromanage. We care about outcomes.



-



About This Role (Read Carefully)



This is a high-expectation Executive Assistant role supporting the CEO directly.



Even though the position is remote, expectations are real from Day 1: speed, accuracy, follow-through, and emotional maturity.



This role exists to:

 • Buy back the CEO’s time immediately 

 • Reduce noise, errors, and dropped details

 • Execute quickly within clear guidelines

 • Improve rapidly through direct feedback



Feedback here is direct and timely because standards are high. The goal is improvement, not perfection—but repeated mistakes signal misalignment.



If something is unclear, elite operators pause and ask first. Once clarified, execution must be fast and precise.



Autonomy is earned quickly through judgment, correction speed, and consistency.



-



What You’ll Own

Calendar & Time Protection

 • Own and manage the CEO’s calendar daily +1 week out

 • Book, reschedule, and confirm events/meetings

 • Enforce calendar rules with discipline

 • Prepare daily sync agenda's and context so nothing is reactive



Communication & Coordination

 • Flag decisions cleanly with relevant context

 • Coordinate logistics, scheduling, reminders, and next steps



Task Tracking & Execution

 • Prepare before asking questions

 • Execute once aligned—fast and clean

 • Create workflows of repeating tasks

-

 • Surface risks, conflicts, or gaps before they become problems

 • Reduce unnecessary interruptions and “quick questions”

 • Act as a true gatekeeper of the CEO’s time



-



Required Experience & Traits

 • Excellent written and spoken English (neutral accent required)

 • AI forward thinking 

 • Highly organized, responsive, and detail-oriented

 • Comfortable in fast-paced, high-expectation environments

 • Emotionally steady and receptive to direct feedback

 • Loyal, discreet, and dependable





-



You Will Thrive Here If You:

 • Think in systems, workflows and outcomes

 • Use AI to support systems, workflows, and outcomes

 • Take responsibility personally

 • Dislike chaos and proactively fix it by immediately building systems so it never happens again

 • Ask smart questions after attempting solutions

This Role Is Not for You If You:

 due to disorganization or oversight, this role will not be a fit. This role requires zero tolerance for missed financial or operational items.

 • Need constant reassurance or validation

 • Guess instead of asking when unclear

 • Take feedback personally

 • Avoid accountability

-



What Success Looks Like

 • Errors are corrected quickly by creating systems and workflows and do not repeat

-



Why This Role Is Different

 • Strong performance leads to expanded responsibility, trust, and compensation

 • This is a long-term role for someone who wants to grow with a CEO—not hop jobs



-

title: Freelance Performance Video Editor for E-Commerce Native Ads & VSLs
description:
We are looking for a Freelance Performance Video Editor for e-commerce native ads and VSLs.



We are building a direct-response e-commerce brand in the medical-adjacent mobility space.



Our product is an EMS foot plate for people struggling with swollen legs, heavy legs, tight ankles, fluid retention, poor circulation feelings, and reduced mobility.



This is not a beauty brand.

This is not a fitness brand.

This is not a generic wellness brand.



We sell a specific product for a specific painful problem.



Our audience is mainly older UK women who are tired of swollen legs, compression stockings, water tablets, heavy ankles, and feeling limited in daily life.



We need someone who can turn validated native ad copy into strong short-form ads, short VSLs, and long-form VSLs.



Important:



This role starts on a freelance basis.



Before we start paid work, we require one small unpaid sample edit.



This is a qualification task.



We want to see your editing style, thinking, B-roll selection, pacing, communication and ability to turn written copy into video.



If the sample is strong, we are ready to move into paid freelance work.



We pay fairly once we see that the skill, execution and communication match what we are looking for.



What you will create:



- Short-form video ads for
, Instagram, TikTok and other paid ad platforms

- Short VSLs

- Long-form VSLs

- Native-style video ads

- Direct-response product videos

- Problem/solution videos

- Hook variations

- Intro variations

- Visual variations from already validated copy



Your main responsibility:



You will take validated native ad copy from us and turn it into strong videos.



This means you must be able to:



- Understand the sales argument

- Understand the customer pain

- Understand the emotional angle

- Understand the product mechanism

- Choose the right visuals

- Source strong B-roll yourself

- Build a video that keeps people watching

- Make the video feel native, trustworthy and clear

- Make the video support the copy instead of distracting from it



You must be comfortable editing videos around topics like:



- Swollen legs

- Heavy legs

- Tight ankles

- Fluid retention

- Poor circulation feelings

- Compression stockings

- Water tablets

- Mobility problems

- EMS foot stimulation

- Calf muscle pump

- Older customer demographics

- At-home health devices



The videos must feel trustworthy, native and clear.



They should not feel fake, childish, overhyped or too “TikTok trendy.”



Our audience needs trust, clarity, emotional relevance and a strong reason to keep watching.



Must-have requirements:



Please do not apply if you do not meet these requirements.



- You have experience editing e-commerce performance ads

- You have experience editing VSLs or direct-response videos

- You understand hooks, pacing, retention and conversion

- You can turn a written script into a complete video without needing every scene explained

- You can source B-roll yourself

- You understand how to visually support a sales message

- You have strong English comprehension

- You can work fast

- You are reliable with deadlines

- You communicate clearly

- You can take feedback without ego

- You have a strong portfolio with real examples



A-player standard:



We are only looking for someone who takes ownership.



An A-player does not wait for every small instruction.



An A-player thinks:



“How can I make this hook stronger?”

“How can I make the video feel more native?”

“How can I make the viewer keep watching?”

“How can I visually support this part of the copy?”

“How can I make this VSL more trustworthy?”

“How can I make this creative perform better?”



If you only want to receive footage, cut clips together and wait for instructions, this role is not for you.



We need someone who can think like a performance editor, not just a normal video editor.



Compensation:



This starts on a freelance basis.



The first sample edit is unpaid and used to qualify the collaboration.



If the sample is strong, we are willing to pay fairly for ongoing freelance work.



At the beginning, compensation depends on experience, quality, speed and output.



As trust, performance and responsibility grow, the pay can increase.



Please send your expected rate for:



1. Short-form ad edit

2. VSL intro edit

3. Full VSL edit

4. Monthly freelance availability



How to apply:



Please send:



1. Your portfolio

2. Your best e-commerce video ad examples

3. Your best VSL or direct-response video examples

4. Your expected rate

5. Your availability per week

6. The tools you use

7. Your internet speed

8. A short Loom video explaining your editing process

9. A short answer to this question:

“How would you turn a validated written native ad copy into a strong VSL?”



Important application rule:



Start your application with the word SCALPURA.



If you do not start with this word, your application will not be reviewed.



Unpaid sample edit:



Shortlisted applicants will receive one small sample edit.



We will give you one validated native ad copy.



Your task is to create one short video sample from that copy.



The sample should show:



- Your hook editing

- Your B-roll selection

- Your pacing

- Your captions/text overlays

- Your ability to visually support the sales message

- Your understanding of native-style performance ads



This first sample edit is unpaid.



Your sample is your first impression.



In paid ads, the first seconds decide if people keep watching or scroll away.



In this hiring process, your sample works the same way.



Show us your best thinking, your best pacing, your best B-roll selection, and your ability to turn validated copy into a strong performance video.



If your sample shows strong skill, good thinking, clear communication and strong execution, we will move into paid freelance work.



We are looking for a long-term freelance partner, not a random one-time editor.

________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

- Accuracy



- Execution quality

- Effort level

________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

title: Instagram Outreach & Management For Ecom Brand
description:
We're a fast-growing direct-to-consumer brand in the health and wellness space. You'll be working with us on this one brand, helping us grow by partnering with Instagram creators to promote our products. We need one reliable person to own that pipeline end-to-end.



Your main job is simple: find new creators, manage them, and report back to me. This starts part-time with a paid trial. If you're great, it becomes a long-term, steady role.



---



## What you'll do

This is the core loop, and you'll own all of it:



1. Find new Instagram creators that fit our brand and audience — this is the heart of the role

2. Send the outreach DM to start the conversation

3. Follow up, and once they're interested, offer them a price

4. Send them a contract to lock in the deal

5. Manage the creators through to delivery — keep them on track and on schedule

6. Report back to me regularly: who you've contacted, who's signed, and what's gone live



## What we're looking for

- Excellent written English — your DMs and follow-ups must sound natural and human, never copy-pasted

- Instagram-native — you understand how creators and the platform actually work

- Comfortable talking numbers and negotiating a price politely and confidently

- Seriously organized and detail-oriented — you live in spreadsheets and never let a follow-up slip

- A self-starter who follows a process without being chased

- Reliable internet and able to work consistent hours



## Bonus points

- Previous influencer/creator outreach or UGC sourcing experience

- Comfortable sending and managing simple creator contracts

- Genuine interest in health, fitness, beauty, or supplements



---



## Details

- Type: Part-time to start (~10–15 hrs/week), with a paid trial task before we commit

- Location: 100% remote / work from home

- Long-term: Steady ongoing role for the right person, with room to grow



---



## How to apply

Read this part carefully — most applicants won't, and that's the first thing we're testing.



1. Start your application with the word "GREENLIGHT" so we know you read this far.

2. In 2–3 sentences, tell us about any outreach or social media work you've done.

3. Include a link to ONE Instagram creator you think would be a great fit for a health/wellness brand, plus one line on why.



Applications that skip any of these three steps won't be reviewed.

title: Insurance Quoting Specialist (Virtual Assistant)
description:
ABOUT US

Aspen Ridge Insurance is a growing independent insurance agency based in Louisville, Kentucky, USA. We are a P&C and Life insurance agency with a focus on Personal Lines including auto and homeowners insurance. We partner with carriers like Erie, Foremost, Geico, Liberty Mutual, National General, Openly, Progressive, and Travelers.

We are a faith-driven, family-first agency. We value integrity, diligence, and treating people — clients and teammates alike — the way we'd want to be treated. The person we hire isn't just filling a seat; they're joining a team we're building for the long haul.



THE ROLE

This starts as a back-office quoting role. For the right person who proves themselves, it can grow over time into more responsibility, including some client-facing work.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Prepare quotes for personal lines (PL) (auto, home, etc.) to support our sales reps

• Prepare quotes for commercial lines (CL) to support our sales reps

• Build clean, accurate quote comparisons for producers to present to clients

• Enter and maintain client and policy data accurately

• Navigate carrier portals and our agency systems to pull what's needed for each quote

• Keep our quoting workflow organized, documented, and moving

• Communicate clearly and promptly with the sales team

• Assist with quotes for current customers

• Mortgage changes

• Administrative tasks



WHAT YOU MUST HAVE (NON-NEGOTIABLE)

• Honesty and Integrity. Anything less is grounds for immediate termination.

• Take Initiative. 

• Be teachable and willing to learn.

• Proven hands-on experience quoting for a US-based independent insurance agency. This is mandatory. Please be specific in your application about which agency, which lines, and how long.

• Excellent written English and clear, professional communication

• Strong, reliable internet — backup internet and/or backup power strongly preferred

• A reliable computer (if you don't have one, we're willing to reimburse you for one)

• Exceptional attention to detail and genuine care about getting numbers right

• Availability full-time during US Eastern business hours

• Stability. We are not looking for a job-hopper. Tenure at your current and prior positions matters a great deal to us — be ready to show it.



NICE TO HAVE (A PLUS; NOT REQUIRED)

• EZLynx

• AgencyZoom

• Gaya AI

• Microsoft 365



COMPENSATION & TERMS

• $700–$1,000/month USD, depending on your experience

• Full-time, with paid holidays and paid time off

• The position begins with a two-week paid trial. This gives both of us a low-pressure window to confirm it's the right fit before committing long-term.

________________________________________

HOW TO APPLY

We read every application carefully, and we want people who do the same. So please read this section closely. Address your message to Mr. Calloway and tell us, in your own words, why this role is a fit for you. We're far more interested in a thoughtful, specific reply than a long one with the first word of your message the word pineapple. Then, in a short paragraph, describe your insurance quoting experience: which agency, which lines of business, what systems you used, and how long you were there.



QUICK SKILLS TASK

Please also complete this short task and include it in your application. It should only take a few minutes — we use it to see how you research, organize, and present information, which is exactly what this role requires:

Aspen Ridge writes homeowners insurance. Find five well-known US home insurance carriers, look up each one's current AM Best financial strength rating, and present them in a simple table — ranked from the strongest rating to the weakest.

That's it. We're excited to meet the right person. Take your time, do it well, and we'll be in touch.

Over the past four years, we have approximately doubled in size each year. Today we manage more than 8,000 apartment homes across Seattle, Tacoma, and Portland and employ a growing team across the United States and the Philippines. We have 230 employees in the US and Philippines.



A key part of our success is Tagumpay, our Philippines-based operations organization. What began as a small team has grown into a group of more than 20 talented professionals supporting resident communications, leasing, administration, marketing, and business operations.



We expect our Philippines organization to continue growing significantly in the years ahead and view Tagumpay as a permanent and strategic part of our company.



We invest heavily in our Philippines team through leadership development, technology, training, and opportunities for advancement. Several of our leaders began in frontline roles and have grown alongside the company.



We are now looking for a People Operations & Recruiting Coordinator to help us build the next chapter of that growth. This is a hands-on leadership role. While the position is expected to grow into managing additional recruiting and people operations team members, the successful candidate will initially execute many recruiting and HR processes directly while helping build the foundation for a larger function.

The right candidate is organized, proactive, professional, and genuinely enjoys helping people succeed. You should be equally comfortable interviewing candidates, coordinating onboarding, supporting employees, and improving internal processes.



This role reports to our future US-based HR leader and will be one of the foundational members of our People Operations function.



As our Philippines team continues to grow, we expect opportunities for advancement into senior recruiting, HR, and people leadership positions.

title: Caregiver Recruiting, Onboarding & Front Office Support
description:
We are seeking an experienced virtual assistant to take ownership of caregiver recruiting, onboarding, and compliance, while also serving as a friendly, professional first point of contact for inbound calls from clients and caregivers. This is a part-time role with strong potential to grow as the business scales.



Schedule

• 20 hours per week to start

• Monday through Thursday

• 5 hours per day

• Must be available to work U.S. Central Time business hours

• Consistent, reliable daily attendance is required and the position requires 100?dication to that role during hours assigned



Primary Responsibilities



Caregiver Recruiting

• Manage the caregiver recruiting pipeline, including reviewing and screening incoming

applications against established hiring criteria (work history, relevant background,

required credentials)

• Verify applicant qualifications such as high school diploma and, for CNAs, a valid CNA

license

• Use a checklist-driven process to determine when candidates are ready to advance to

the next stage

• Work within an applicant tracking platform, Apploi, to move candidates through the

recruiting workflow, mark applicants ready for background checks, and trigger follow-ups

• Schedule interviews and coordinate candidate communication



Onboarding

• Handle the full onboarding process for new caregivers, including pre-hire and post-hire

paperwork

• Initiate and track background checks

• Collect and verify required documentation, including driver's license, auto insurance, and

other compliance items

• Transfer hired caregivers into payroll software

• Provision new caregiver accounts and access in the training platform

• Ensure all accounts are set up correctly and all documentation is filed in the right place



Compliance & Caregiver Retention

• Maintain ongoing compliance, including annual background checks and insurance

renewals

• Track caregiver certifications and qualifications to ensure they remain current

• Keep up with recurring compliance requirements and flag items that need attention



Front Office & Phone Support

• Answer inbound calls from clients and caregivers in a professional, courteous manner

• Conduct client intake and gather the right information to advance each inquiry to the next

step

• Know which calls to route and to whom, transferring callers appropriately

• Be knowledgeable about the agency's programs and services in order to speak

confidently with callers

• Provide general administrative assistant support, including managing schedules and

calendars and helping coordinate meetings



Required Qualifications

• Multiple years of caregiver recruiting experience

• Demonstrated experience with caregiver onboarding and compliance processes

• Strong phone skills with a clear, neutral accent

• Proven experience speaking with a U.S.-based client base, ideally within the healthcare

space

• Highly organized with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple

workflows simultaneously

• Comfortable learning and working across multiple software platforms

• Reliable, self-directed, and able to work consistent scheduled hours independently

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills



Preferred Qualifications

• Caregiver recruiting experience specifically within the home care industry (strong plus)

• Familiarity with applicant tracking, payroll, and caregiver training platforms; experience

with Apploi is a plus

• Experience with both patient/client-facing intake and back-office administrative work



Tools & Systems

The role involves working within the agency's recruiting platform, payroll software, caregiver

training platform, and phone system. Prior experience with these specific tools is not required;

training will be provided, and the ability to quickly learn new systems is what matters most.

What Success Looks Like

This person will own the caregiver onboarding pipeline and serve as a dependable first line of

contact for clients and caregivers, freeing the owners to focus on growing the business.

Success will be measured against clear goals, such as a target number of caregivers

onboarded per pay period, alongside reliability, information retention, and the quality of client

and caregiver interactions.

title: GHL Virtual Assistant – Marketing Systems, Tech & Automation (Part-Time, Growth Potential)
description:
**About Me**



My name is Cami and I am a mom of 3 from Oklahoma City, Oklahoma (USA). I have been in the online marketing world since 2016 after quitting teaching to stay home with my son. I am growing my business in between naps and soccer practice and could really use some assistance to get more done with the limited time that I have.



I run a SaaS business built on a white-labeled version of GoHighLevel, helping clients set up automated marketing and follow-up systems. My clients fall into two groups: local businesses (chiropractors, plumbers, service providers, etc.) who need lead capture and follow-up systems, and online experts/coaches who need tech and marketing support for their digital product businesses. 



**About the Role**



I'm looking for a reliable, detail-oriented VA who has hands-on GHL experience and is eager to grow their skills with me. This is a part-time role to start (up to 10 hours/week) with strong potential to grow into more hours — and more responsibility — as the business scales.



I sometimes approach things a little differently than a typical agency setup, so I need someone who can follow my direction closely, ask good clarifying questions, and not just default to "the way it's usually done." I'd rather have someone coachable and detail-oriented than someone who's set in their ways.



**What You'll Be Doing**



- Building and editing GHL workflows, automations, and pipelines (missed call text-back, review requests, follow-up sequences, etc.)

- Setting up and maintaining GHL sub-accounts for new clients using templates/snapshots

- Building funnels and websites inside GHL

- Helping organize and clean up automations as the system grows

- Supporting both local business clients and online expert/coach clients, depending on what's needed week to week

- Occasionally helping with marketing content support (using AI tools to draft, edit, or refine copy)

- Flagging things that look off from a design or user-experience standpoint, even if you're not a designer



**Must-Haves**



- Real hands-on experience with GoHighLevel (this is non-negotiable — please don't apply if you've only used other CRMs)

- Comfortable using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) to support your work

- Strong written English — clear, professional, and easy to understand

- A good eye for what looks clean and professional, even without formal design training

- Coachable — willing to learn my way of doing things, ask questions instead of guessing

- Reliable communication and availability for part-time, flexible hours (up to 10/week to start)



**Nice-to-Haves**



- General understanding of online/digital marketing (funnels, follow-up sequences, lead nurture)

- Experience with Canva

- Experience in Customer Support for GHL

- Experience supporting a small business, solo agency owner, or online coach/expert (not just a big team)



**Hours & Pay**



Part-time, up to 10 hours/week to start, with the opportunity to grow into more hours and responsibility as we add clients. **Pay: $8/hour**, with room to grow as you take on more.



**To Apply**



Please include the word "BUILDER" in the subject line of your application so I know you read the full post. Also, tell me: what's one GHL workflow or automation you've built, and what would you do differently if you built it again?



NOTE: I will be having the top applicants complete a sample paid project. Please do not apply if you are not willing to do that.

title: Financial Controller
description:
Company Overview

FetchMe LLC is an Atlanta-based restaurant technology platform—the “Shopify for Restaurants”—powering ~200 merchants across 30 metros with an integrated delivery and catering operations layer. Currently at $3M ARR and actively raising a Series A, we are moving fast to build the best restaurant operating system while keeping costs low for our merchants. Our mission focuses on helping independent restaurants reclaim revenue from high-fee aggregators by giving them the tools to run their own high-margin delivery and catering channels.

Our finance operations span multi-market driver pay, complex merchant payment reconciliation, and the high-level reporting discipline required to be investor-ready. We run lean, move fast, and value operational efficiency.



Position Summary:

Type: Full-time, 40 hours/week

Location: Remote (Philippines)

Hours: U.S. Business Hours (significant CST overlap required; exact schedule has flexibility, but core availability during peak U.S. morning/afternoon hours is necessary for team alignment).

Reports to: Co-Founder / Chief Growth Officer (dotted line to CEO, Atlanta)

Compensation: $13–$17/hr, commensurate with experience (FTE ~$27K–$35K/year)



The Financial Controller is a hands-on role dedicated to owning the day-to-day accounting close and bringing extreme rigor to a high-transaction-volume, multi-market operation. This is an ownership seat for the books, reconciliations, and the strict controls required to keep them flawless. You will work directly with the founding team and have a highly visible impact on our Series A diligence readiness.



Core Responsibilities

1. Financial Reporting & Month-End Close

Full Close Ownership: Run the entire month-end close cycle, including journal entries, accruals, and GL reconciliation.

Reporting Packages: Deliver a clean, accurate, and on-time monthly financial package.

Diligence Support: Prepare financial schedules and reconciliations that feed directly into board reporting and investor diligence.

2. High-Volume Reconciliation & Spend Management

Stripe / Payment Processing: Reconcile payments, refunds, and disputes across a growing merchant base (currently ~50 active merchants). Investigate and resolve all variances to zero.

Driver Payroll: Tie out our multi-market driver pay infrastructure (hourly guarantees and catering workbooks) before payroll runs through Everee. Enforce a strict zero-variance tie-out prior to platform upload.

Merchant Payouts: Reconcile merchant-level revenue, platform fees, and final payouts across all active markets; flag and resolve discrepancies immediately.

Corporate Spend Ownership: Manage and optimize our Ramp spend management platform—overseeing corporate card workflows, expense auto-coding, receipt compliance, and bill pay mapping.

3. Treasury, AP/AR, & Internal Controls

Cash Management: Maintain routine cash position reporting and assist the founders in tracking burn-rate metrics.

AP/AR: Manage vendor invoicing, corporate expenses, and receivables tracking.

Controls & Documentation: Build, maintain, and improve internal controls and process documentation to ensure the close process is repeatable and audit-ready.

Process Automation: Document manual workflows and actively look for opportunities to make them AI-enabled or automated, ensuring that money-movement steps always require human approval.



Candidate Qualifications

Must-Have Requirements

Experience: 3+ years in accounting/controller roles, ideally supporting a U.S.-based company.

GL Ownership: Demonstrated experience running an entire month-end close cycle independently, not just supporting it.

Software Proficiencies: Advanced, hands-on proficiency with QuickBooks Online (QBO), Ramp (or a closely comparable spend management / AP platform), and Advanced Excel (comfortable managing complex, multi-tab workbooks using advanced formulas, flags, and tie-out logic).

Transaction Volume: Proven experience managing high-volume data reconciliation (e.g., payment processors, payroll platforms, or gig-economy settlement systems).

AI Fluency: Actively leverages tools like ChatGPT, Claude, or similar to accelerate analysis, formula building, and reporting—while maintaining strong judgment around AI limitations and the need for human oversight on financial data.

Communication: C1/C2 level English with exceptional written and verbal skills for seamless collaboration with a U.S. founding team.

Infrastructure: A stable remote workspace with reliable internet and consistent availability for required U.S. CST overlap.

Nice-to-Have Attributes

Tech Stack Experience: Direct experience with Stripe, Everee (or similar payroll disbursement platforms), and Notion (where our core operational infrastructure lives).

ERP & Scaling: Exposure to NetSuite or similar ERPs, helpful for future migration as the company scales.

Automation Skills: Experience designing AI-assisted or automated workflows, prompt-driven reporting, or light scripting to eliminate manual close tasks.

Industry Background: Prior experience in high-growth SaaS, marketplaces, gig-economy platforms, logistics, or restaurant technology.



Benefits & Perks

Performance Bonus: Eligibility for performance-based bonuses tied to milestones like successful close cycles, audit readiness, and process efficiency.

Paid Time Off: Comprehensive PTO package aligned with observed US and PH holidays to ensure a balanced schedule.

Professional Development: Dedicated annual budget for accounting certifications, advanced software training, or technical workshops.

Schedule Flexibility: Enjoy some autonomy over your daily calendar, provided significant core CST collaboration hours are maintained.



What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)

Day 30: Fully up to speed on the internal Stripe, Everee, Ramp, and driver-pay workbooks. Successfully shadowing and taking over weekly reconciliations.

Day 60: Running the month-end close with minimal oversight and executing flawless, zero-variance driver pay tie-outs on every cycle.

Day 90: Fully owning the close process independently, delivering the financial package strictly on the calendar, and having proposed at least two concrete process improvements to existing controls.



How to Apply

Please submit your résumé along with a cover letter detailing your most relevant, high-volume data reconciliation experience.

Note: Strong candidates will be invited to complete a short, paid reconciliation exercise to demonstrate proficiency.

title: VSL Video Editor (Paid Per Minute) — Direct-Response E-Commerce
description:
We are a fast-growing e-commerce health & wellness brand selling through direct-response video ads (VSLs) on Meta. We are scaling fast and need an EXPERIENCED VSL editor who has actually cut and edited VSLs before — not just social media content or YouTube videos.



IMPORTANT: We pay per finished minute of VSL — $5 to $7 per minute depending on quality and complexity. High-quality work = higher rate. This is a long-term, ongoing role with consistent volume.



HOW WE WORK

We provide everything you need to get started:

- The full script / copy (English, beat-mapped)

- The voiceover (pre-recorded)

- Example VSLs showing the exact style and direction we want

- Briefing for each project



YOUR JOB is the creative execution: editing, pacing, captions, B-roll, sound design, visual hooks — you turn our script and voiceover into a scroll-stopping, high-converting VSL. We provide the ingredients, you cook the meal.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Edit 2–4 VSLs per week (starting with 2, scaling based on results)

- Cut and assemble the full VSL from provided voiceover, script, and reference material

- Add word-by-word animated captions

- Source and place B-roll, stock footage, or simple motion graphics where needed

- Add sound design, music, pacing, and visual hooks that hold attention

- Match the style of the reference VSLs we provide

- Iterate fast when we ask for variations on winning ads



MUST-HAVE (non-negotiable)

- You have ACTUALLY CUT AND EDITED VSLs before — show us in your portfolio. Social media edits, YouTube videos, or montages do NOT count. We need direct-response VSL experience.

- Strong skills in CapCut (primary editing tool)

- Experience with ElevenLabs or similar AI voiceover tools

- Animated / word-by-word captions (CapCut auto-captions or Submagic)

- Strong sense of pacing, retention, and hook structure for direct-response ads

- Fluent English (all communication is in English)



NICE-TO-HAVE (big plus)

- Adobe Premiere Pro / After Effects for advanced cuts or motion graphics

- B-roll sourcing experience (Storyblocks, Artgrid, etc.)

- Understanding German (our audience is German-speaking women 50+)

- Experience editing for health, wellness, or 50+ audiences

- Experience with multiple DTC / e-commerce brands



TOOLS WE USE

CapCut, ElevenLabs, Submagic, Google Drive, Meta Ads, Slack



PAY STRUCTURE

$5 to $7 per finished minute of VSL. Rate depends on quality and complexity. Consistently great work earns the top rate. We pay per delivered VSL, not per hour — so the faster and better you work, the more you earn.



Example: A 5-minute VSL at $6/min = $30 per VSL. At 2 VSLs per week, that's ~$240/month. At 4 VSLs per week with top rate, significantly more.



WORK STYLE

High-performance, fast-moving e-commerce environment. We value editors who think about WHY an ad converts, not just where to cut. Deadlines are firm, but workload is flexible and grows with results.

title: Podcast Audio Editor / Post-Production Producer Long-Term Role
description:
We are looking for a skilled Podcast Audio Editor / Post-Production Producer based in the Philippines to help edit and polish podcast episodes for our growing content brands.



Our shows include Forged to Rise, which focuses on faith, personal development, leadership, mindset, and transformation, as well as Thrive2Peak / Pro2Peak, which includes health, performance, clinical, and informational content.



We need someone who does more than basic audio cleanup. The right person understands how to make a podcast sound professional, engaging, clear, and emotionally strong. You should know how to improve pacing, remove distractions, clean audio naturally, and help the listener stay engaged from beginning to end.



This is a long-term role for the right editor.



Responsibilities



Your main responsibilities will include:



Editing raw podcast recordings into polished final episodes.

Cleaning background noise, clicks, mouth sounds, hum, echo, and other distractions.

Balancing host and guest audio levels.

Removing long pauses, repeated phrases, major filler words, false starts, and mistakes.

Improving pacing and flow while keeping the conversation natural.

Adding intro music, outro music, and any provided audio segments.

Mastering final audio to professional podcast loudness standards.

Exporting final files in MP3 and WAV format.

Organizing files clearly in Google Drive.

Communicating updates and questions clearly.

Making revisions based on feedback.

Optional: creating short audio/video clips, show notes, episode titles, or YouTube podcast edits if you have those skills.



What We’re Looking For



We are looking for someone who:



Has experience editing podcasts, interviews, sermons, coaching content, educational content, or long-form conversations.

Has strong English listening comprehension.

Understands pacing, storytelling, and listener retention.

Can make audio sound clean without making it robotic or over-processed.

Knows when to remove filler words and when to leave natural speech alone.

Can work independently without needing constant supervision.

Is organized, reliable, and deadline-driven.

Is open to feedback and willing to learn our show style.

Can work asynchronously with a team based in New Jersey, USA, Eastern Time.

Required Skills



You should be comfortable with at least one of the following tools:



Adobe Audition

Reaper

Audacity

Logic Pro

Pro Tools

Descript

DaVinci Resolve

Adobe Premiere Pro



Audio skills should include:



Noise reduction

EQ

Compression

De-essing

Breath and mouth-click cleanup

Volume leveling

Multitrack editing

Intro/outro music placement

Final mastering/export



Experience with iZotope RX, Auphonic, Descript, Riverside, or video podcast editing is a plus.



Content Style



Our content has two main styles:



1. Faith / personal development / motivational content

For this type of episode, the edit should preserve emotion, conviction, pauses, and impact. We do not want the conversation over-edited or made to sound unnatural.



2. Health / performance / clinical / informational content

For this type of episode, the edit should prioritize clarity, clean structure, and easy listener understanding. Repetition and rambling should be tightened while preserving the meaning of what was said.



The right editor should understand the difference between these two styles.



Typical Episode Details

Average raw episode length: 45–60 minutes

Speakers: Usually 1 host + 1 guest

Turnaround target: 48–72 hours per episode

Work type: Part-time to start, with potential for long-term ongoing work

Timezone: We are based in New Jersey, USA, Eastern Time

Collaboration style: Mostly async using Google Drive, Loom, and messaging

Pay



We are open to either per-episode pay or a monthly arrangement after a trial period.







Possible monthly arrangement after trial:

depending on workload, speed, quality, and deliverables.



Higher pay is possible for someone who can also handle video podcast editing, short-form clips, show notes, or publishing support.



Paid Test Project



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a paid test edit using a 10–15 minute raw podcast segment.



The test will help us evaluate:



Audio quality

Pacing

Naturalness of the edit

Ability to remove distractions without over-editing

Communication

File delivery

Deadline reliability



Please do not apply if you are not willing to complete a paid test project.



How to Apply



Please start your application with this exact phrase:



“I edit for listener retention.”



Then answer the following questions:



What podcast editing software do you use?

How many podcasts or long-form episodes have you edited?

Please send 2–3 samples of podcast episodes you edited.

Do you have any before-and-after samples?

What is your typical turnaround time for a 45–60 minute raw episode?

What is your rate per episode?

Are you available for ongoing weekly work?

How do you d
 what to cut and what to keep in a conversation?

Have you edited faith-based, motivational, coaching, health, medical, or educational content before?

What are your normal working hours in Philippine time?

Who This Role Is Not For



This role is not for someone who:



Only runs AI noise cleanup and exports the file.

Has no podcast editing samples.

Over-edits conversations until they sound unnatural.

Cannot follow instructions.

Misses deadlines without communication.

Does not understand English well enough to edit for meaning and flow.

Only focuses on technical cleanup and does not care about the listener experience.

Final Note



We are looking for a reliable long-term editor who can grow with our content brands. If you are skilled, organized, thoughtful, and care about creating high-quality podcast episodes, we would love to hear from you.

 Ads

Turning product images into realistic lifestyle images and videos

Creating realistic AI models wearing our fashion products

Writing or improving UGC scripts and hooks

Creating natural voiceovers and customer-style dialogue

Editing videos with captions, music, transitions, product close-ups, and strong hooks

Making creatives that feel realistic, natural, and not overly AI-generated

Creating ads designed to stop scrolling and drive clicks, sales, and conversions

Testing different angles for women’s fashion products

Working quickly and delivering creatives daily

Taking feedback and improving creatives based on performance

Strong video editing skills

Ability to create realistic human/model videos using AI

Strong attention to detail

Fast delivery and reliable communication

A creative mindset and willingness to test new ideas

Work Style



This is a full-time remote position with an immediate start.



We are looking for someone long-term who can grow with our fashion e-commerce brands. You must be available daily, work quickly, and be comfortable receiving feedback.

title: Senior Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) Expert
description:
Summary

Introduction:



We are a fast-growing e-commerce company specializing in drop shipping, with a strong foothold in the European market and ambitious plans to expand into the USA. To drive growth

and maximize performance, we are looking for a Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) Expert.



To join our team full-time. This role is vital in optimizing our sales funnels, testing offers, and improving the overall customer journey to achieve more conversions and grow sales.



We are seeking a Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) Expert to join our team full-time. This is a pivotal role where you will take charge of crafting strategies, analyzing data, and leading our

funnel-building team to drive measurable improvements in performance.



Your work will directly impact key metrics such as ROAS, CPA, and AOV, making you a key contributor to the

company’s growth.



Responsibilities:

1. Strategy and Testing:



Develop a comprehensive strategy for the initial testing phase of funnels and implement split tests for ongoing optimization.



Test and analyze different strategies to identify the most effective methods for driving conversions and increasing revenue (offers/pricing/designs etc.)



2. Leadership and Management:



Lead and manage the funnel-building team, ensuring seamless implementation and alignment with company goals.



Oversee the creation and optimization of sales funnels on Funnelish or similar tools.



Train the funnel-building team and creative staff on CRO best practices and strategies.



Foster a culture of continuous improvement and knowledge sharing.



3. Creative Alignment:



Collaborate closely with the creative team to ensure ad creatives are aligned with funnel designs and marketing angles.



Provide feedback and insights to adjust creatives based on funnel performance.



4. Data Analysis and Reporting:



Analyze customer behavior and performance data using tools like Funnelish Analytics, Google Analytics, Hotjar, and heatmaps to identify friction points and areas for improvement.



Create detailed weekly/monthly reports on key metrics



Develop actionable recommendations based on data insights and test results.



5. Funnel and UX Optimization:



Optimize landing pages for better user experience (UX) and higher conversion rates by addressing design, speed, and clarity.



Identify and eliminate customer journey friction points.



6. Checkout Process and Retention Optimization:



Implement post-purchase upsell and cross-sell strategies to drive higher



Average Order Value (AOV).



Develop retention strategies, including
 and SMS re-engagement campaigns and loyalty programs.



7. Competitor and Market Analysis:



Regularly analyze competitors’ pricing, offers, and funnel strategies to identify gaps and opportunities.



Skills and Qualifications:



Proven experience in conversion rate optimization within an e-commerce or drop shipping environment for 2+ years

Strong understanding of funnel-building platforms (e.g., Funnelish, ClickFunnels) and analytics tools (Google Analytics, Hotjar).



Demonstrated ability to develop and execute data-driven CRO strategies.



Experience in testing offers, pricing models, and A/B testing for digital funnels.



Exceptional analytical skills and proficiency with data visualization tools.



Strong communication and collaboration skills, with experience working cross-functionally with creative and marketing teams.

Proactive problem-solving skills and a results-driven mindset.



Compensation & Growth:



Base salary of $1.000 - 1,500/month.

Performance-based bonuses are tied to funnel performance metrics such as improved conversion rates and profits

Opportunities for professional development and growth within a dynamic and fast-growing company.



We are looking for a strategic, data-driven CRO Expert who is passionate about optimizing customer journeys and driving measurable results. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and

have a proven track record in improving funnel performance, we would love to hear from you.



To apply, please answer the following questions in detail AND share your resume and a portfolio showcasing your CRO achievements, along with a brief explanation of your testing and

optimization approach.



1. Can you describe your experience with conversion rate optimization (CRO) for e-commerce or drop shipping businesses?

2. Have you worked with sales funnels before? If so, which platforms (e.g., Funnelish, ClickFunnels)?

3. Can you provide an example of an A/B or split test you conducted? What were the results, and what did you learn?

4. What tools do you use for data analysis?

5. What is your current occupation, and are you available for full-time work and able to commit to daily CRO tasks?

6. Can you provide a portfolio or examples of past work, highlighting successful optimization projects?

title: Bookkeeper & Financial Reporting Assistant (Xero) Bookkeeper & Financial Reporting Assistant (Xero) — Part-Time to Full
description:
Job Title: Bookkeeper & Financial Reporting Assistant (Xero) — Part-Time to Full-Time

Salary: ?40,000/month full-time equivalent (pro-rata during part-time training period)

We're a UK-based service company. We're looking for a detail-oriented bookkeeper who's confident in Xero and comfortable moving between two very different kinds of work: the day-to-day mundane stuff (invoicing, chasing payment queries) and more analytical monthly reporting (variance analysis, cash flow forecasting, KPI tracking).

This is not a data-entry-only role. We want someone who will look at the numbers and tell us when something looks wrong, not just someone who enters them.

How this works

You'll start part-time on a paid trial so we can train you properly and make sure it's a good fit on both sides. If that goes well, we'll move you to a full-time role at ?40,000/month.

What you'll actually be doing

In Xero:



Raising and sending invoices

Responding to and resolving invoice queries from customers

Monitoring the aged receivables report and chasing overdue accounts (professionally, not aggressively)

Reconciling subcontractor invoices for waste collections and skip hire against what we've billed out



In reporting (we use a six-tab monthly pack):



Overheads — budget vs actual, flagging anything more than 10% out and helping us understand why

Direct costs — gross margin by service line

Balance sheet — sense-checking the numbers, not just transcribing them

Accounts receivable — aging and trends

Cash flow forecasting — we want help building this out properly, it's currently a work in progress

KPI and metrics tracking from our operational data



What we need from you



Solid, hands-on experience with Xero — not just basic invoicing, ideally including reporting, tracking categories, and reconciliations

Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills — formulas, not just typing numbers into cells

Comfortable with both repetitive admin work and more analytical tasks — we need flexibility, not a specialist in just one

Good written English for customer-facing invoice query
s

Someone who asks questions when something's unclear, rather than guessing



What we don't need



A finance degree or formal qualifications — we care about demonstrated skill, not paper

Previous experience in waste management specifically



How to apply

Send your CV along with a short note (2-3 sentences) on your Xero experience — specifically what kind of reporting or reconciliation work you've done, not just invoicing. Applications without this won't be considered.

Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a short paid test task before any full-time offer, so you can see exactly what the work involves before committing either way.

Your experience with Claude and Higgsfield in 3 lines maximum

title: Senior Copywriter For Email Marketing Agency
description:
We're a boutique
 marketing agency building world-class Klaviyo programs for Shopify brands in fashion, spirits, jewelry, and beyond. We're small, fast, and obsessive about craft.



We're looking for a senior
 copywriter who'll rewrite a subject line twenty times, then cut a line they love because it doesn't sound like the brand.



What you'll do:



Own the words for multiple brands: concepting, writing, and shipping
 and SMS copy that gets designed, built in Klaviyo, and sent to hundreds of thousands of subscribers. Subject lines, preview text, body copy, CTAs, all of it.



Every week you move between brand worlds. High-end modest fashion one hour, premium whisky the next, streetwear after lunch. Each one has its own voice, and you switch between them without missing a beat. You'll work with our designers and strategists to turn briefs into
s that stop the scroll and move revenue.



And the more you show us, the more you shape. The best writers here don't just write to the brief, they help d
 what the brief should be: the angle, the offer, the calendar, the strategy behind the send.



How it works:



This is a per-account role. You're paid per account you own, and the better you do, the more accounts you get. There's no ceiling. Deliver, and you keep earning more. How far this goes is up to you.



Who we're looking for:



• 3+ years writing
 copy, specifically. Not "I write, and some of it was
." Real campaigns, real results, real revenue. You know the medium cold: the subject line, the preview text, the first line, scannability, the CTA, and how copy maps to a Klaviyo block structure.

• Native-level English on the page. Not just correct, but idiom, rhythm, and the instinct for when to break a rule. You write English that sounds like a person, not a translation and not a textbook.

• A body of work that makes us jealous. Voice, rhythm, restraint, taste. Your
s read like someone wrote them for a brand they love, not like a template and not like a prompt.

• You're a voice chameleon. You can sound like premium whisky in the morning and streetwear by lunch, and neither one sounds like you. Brand voice isn't a vibe you approximate. It's something you nail, every time.

• AI is already in your toolkit, and you've figured out how to use it without sounding like it. Claude, ChatGPT, whatever sharpens your thinking and speeds up your drafts. But you'd never let an "elevate," an "unleash," or an "in a world where" slip into a send. You know the difference between AI that makes you faster and AI that makes you generic, and you only ship the first kind. If you're scared of AI, or addicted to its first draft, this isn't the role.

• You understand
 as a discipline, not just a writing assignment. You know what a flow is, why segmentation changes what you write, and how the offer and the angle move revenue. Bonus points if you can build the strategy, not just write to it.

• You get design. You write with the layout in mind: how copy breaks across blocks, where the eye lands, what the headline does next to the hero. You'll push back on a layout that fights the words instead of just filling it in.

• You overlap with Israel hours. Wherever you're based, your workday meets ours. This one is non-negotiable. We move fast and need you in the room, even when the room is Slack.





Why it's worth it: 



• Your words ship, unwatered. We're small enough that nothing dies in committee. What you write Monday is in inboxes by Friday.

• Brands worth writing for. Our clients care how they sound. No "just make it pop" briefs, no "add three more exclamation points," and a body of work you'll be proud of.

• Direct feedback, fast growth. We tell you what's working and what isn't. No politics, no guessing where you stand.





We live by five values: Unreasonable Hospitality, Design + Details, Extreme Ownership, Relentlessly Resourceful, and Clarity is King. If reading those made you nod, we should talk. If they made you roll your eyes, we won't.



How to apply



There's one way in: our Google form:

This is not a basic call center supervisor role. The ideal candidate must be able to lead debt collection agents, customer service agents, and insurance support agents while also maintaining accurate financial records related to items such as payment issues, account adjustments, chargeback disputes, and customer documentation.



We are looking for an A-player who is organized, detail-oriented, accountable, numbers-driven, and capable of managing both people and process quality in a fast-paced finance environment.



Key Responsibilities

Team Supervision

Supervise daily performance of collections, customer service, and insurance support agents.

Coach agents on proper call handling, negotiation, documentation, escalation, and customer service standards.

Ensure agents make proper collection efforts, document account activity accurately, and follow approved communication standards.

Review call outcomes, payment promises, customer disputes, escalation cases, and unresolved accounts.

Support improvement of collection performance, right-party contact rates, promise-to-pay quality, and customer resolution rates.



Customer Service and Insurance Support

Supervise customer service agents handling borrower inquiries, account questions, payment questions, and service requests.

Ensure customer issues are handled professionally, accurately, and within expected turnaround times.

Escalate sensitive or high-risk customer issues to U.S. management when needed.



Financial Record Maintenance and Chargeback Support

Assist with accurate financial record maintenance related to customer accounts.

Review and support documentation for payment disputes, returned payments, chargebacks, account corrections, and adjustment requests.

Maintain organized records of customer communications, payment issues, dispute documentation, and internal approvals.

Coordinate with accounting, finance, servicing, and operations teams to ensure records are accurate and properly supported.

Identify process gaps that may create payment errors, documentation issues, or customer disputes.



Reporting and Process Control

Prepare clear daily and weekly performance summaries for management.

Track agent-level productivity, quality, escalations, unresolved tasks, and operational bottlenecks.

Use reports and system data to identify underperformance, training needs, process issues, and improvement opportunities.

Recommend practical improvements to workflows, scripts, documentation, and agent accountability.



Required Experience

Minimum 3–5 years of experience in call center operations, collections, financial services, customer service, insurance support, BPO operations, or similar fields.

Minimum 1–2 years of supervisory or team lead experience managing agents, preferably in a U.S. account.

Experience supervising debt collections, financial services, auto finance, lending, banking, insurance, payment processing, or customer service teams is strongly preferred.

Experience handling or supporting chargebacks, payment disputes, account adjustments, billing issues, or financial documentation is preferred.

Experience working with U.S. companies, U.S. customers, or U.S. business hours is preferred.



Required Skills

Strong leadership and agent coaching ability.

Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.

Strong attention to detail and documentation accuracy.

Ability to understand financial account activity, payment history, account notes, disputes, and customer records.

Ability to enforce procedures while maintaining professionalism and fairness.

Strong problem-solving skills and ability to resolve operational issues without constant supervision.

Comfortable reviewing calls, account notes, reports, and performance data.

Strong Excel skills.

Ability to manage multiple departments or work queues at the same time.

High integrity when handling customer information, payment-related records, and confidential company data.



Preferred Qualifications

Experience with U.S. auto finance, consumer lending, debt collection, BPO collections, insurance verification, or payment processing.

Experience with CRMs, loan servicing systems, dialers, ticketing systems, or call center platforms.

Experience creating SOPs, call scripts, coaching forms, QA feedback, or agent scorecards.

Experience working night shift or U.S. Central Time schedule.

Bachelor’s degree required, exception possible if the candidate has strong relevant experience.



Performance Expectations

The successful candidate will be measured on:

Team productivity and task completion.

Collection agent performance and customer resolution rates.

Customer service response quality and turnaround time.

Insurance verification follow-up quality.

Accuracy of account notes, documentation, and financial records.

Chargeback and dispute documentation quality.

Agent attendance, accountability, and coaching effectiveness.

Call quality and compliance with company procedures.



Compensation and Incentives

Competitive monthly base salary.

Performance-based incentive plan.

Long-term growth opportunity with a U.S.-based finance company.

Remote work arrangement.

Ideal Candidate Profile

Technical and Remote Work Requirements

Required Equipment

Candidate must have:

title: Funnel Specialist
description:
About The Visionary Group (TVG)



Welcome to The Visionary Group. We are a close knit e-commerce growth team of brand builders, strategists, and marketers. We help companies scale to maximum their true potential by exploring DTC solutions best suit for their stage of business. Founded in 2022, our collection of fast paced tea
mbers is becoming filled with high priority work, which is where you come in!



What this position is responsible for:



We’re looking for a highly analytical and execution-focused DTC Funnel Optimization Specialist who can identify conversion bottlenecks, implement high-impact fixes, and continuously improve the customer journey across our eCommerce client portfolio. This role exists to bridge the gap between paid acquisition and on-site conversion performance, ensuring traffic generated by our Paid Media Strategists converts at the highest possible rate. You’ll own the diagnosis, testing, implementation, and reporting of funnel improvements while helping scale winning conversion strategies across multiple brands.



Requirements/Experience:



- 2+ years of experience in Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), DTC eCommerce, funnel optimization, or Shopify growth operations



- Strong working knowledge of Shopify and DTC customer acquisition funnels



- Experience using tools such as GA4, Triple Whale, Shopify Analytics, Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, or similar analytics platforms



- Hands-on experience building and updating landing pages and pre-sale pages using Replo or similar no-code builders



- Familiarity with quiz funnel platforms such as Octane AI, Shop Quiz, TryNow, or related tools



- Experience implementing and analyzing A/B tests using tools like Convert, GLO, Intelligems, or equivalent testing platforms



- Strong understanding of key eCommerce conversion metrics including LP CVR, PDP CVR, ATC rate, checkout completion rate, AOV, and funnel conversion flow



- Ability to write high-converting CRO-focused copy including headlines, CTAs, benefit-driven bullets, and trust-building messaging



- Strong analytical thinking with the ability to prioritize opportunities based on impact and effort



- Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple client funnels simultaneously



- Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with Paid Media Strategists and internal stakeholders



- High attention to detail and strong bias toward execution and accountability



- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, performance-driven remote environment



Roles & Responsibilities for this position:



- Conduct monthly audits of each client’s full acquisition funnel, including the transition from ad creative to landing page/PDP, add-to-cart flow, checkout experience, and post-purchase confirmation journey



- Analyze funnel performance data using GA4, Triple Whale, Shopify Analytics, Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, and related tools to identify drop-off points, friction areas, and conversion opportunities



- Develop and maintain a prioritized “funnel fix queue” for each client based on projected revenue lift, implementation effort, and business impact



- Collaborate closely with Paid Media Strategists to identify and communicate systemic funnel issues, including disconnects between ad messaging and landing page experience



- Build, launch, and optimize pre-sale pages in Replo to support paid acquisition campaigns and improve conversion performance



- Create, update, and maintain quiz funnels using tools such as Octane AI, Shop Quiz, TryNow, and similar platforms

Implement updates to product detail pages (PDPs) using Shopify-native apps and templated modules without requiring custom Liquid development



- Launch and optimize landing pages designed specifically for paid traffic campaigns and conversion-focused customer journeys



- Execute structured A/B testing initiatives using platforms such as Convert, GLO, or Intelligems, ensuring proper setup, tracking, and reporting



- Write and refine conversion-focused copy for headlines, subheads, product bullets, CTAs, badges, and other on-site conversion elements



- Run a minimum of two A/B tests per client each month, continuously iterating based on performance insights and learnings



- Maintain a centralized testing log documenting hypotheses, variants, results, learnings, and next-step recommendations across all client accounts



- Identify winning conversion patterns and scalable best practices, then templatize and implement them across the broader client portfolio



- Own and monitor core funnel performance metrics including landing page CVR, PDP CVR, ATC rate, checkout completion rate, AOV, quiz completion rate, and quiz-to-purchase rate



- Provide weekly funnel performance updates and actionable insights to Paid Media Strategists via Slack



- Contribute funnel performance insights and scorecard data to monthly client reporting deliverables



- Take full ownership of implementation timelines, optimization initiatives, and measurable funnel performance improvements across assigned accounts



Notes:

- Must be available to work CST hours

- ASAP hire - immediate availability preferred

- Must be based in the Philippines



Apply now!

title: Amazon FBA Operations Manager
description:
Amazon Operations Manager – Glittery Craft

Position: Amazon Operations Manager

Location: Remote (Philippines Preferred)

Type: Full-Time



About Us

Glittery Craft is an established Amazon FBA business selling branded party supplies, craft kits, and productivity products across multiple Amazon marketplaces, including the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Europe, Australia, and Mexico.

.

We are seeking a highly organized Amazon Operations Manager to oversee the day-to-day operations of the business and serve as the primary coordinator between suppliers, freight forwarders, Amazon, and management.



Position Overview

The Amazon Operations Manager will be responsible for ensuring products remain in stock, inventory is forecasted accurately, shipments are created and tracked, suppliers are managed effectively, and operational issues are resolved quickly.



This role is ideal for someone with significant Amazon FBA experience who enjoys managing complex operations and solving problems proactively.



Primary Responsibilities

Inventory Planning & Forecasting

• Monitor inventory levels across all Amazon marketplaces.

• Forecast inventory needs based on sales trends and seasonality.

• Prepare monthly replenishment plans.

• Identify stock-out risks and recommend corrective actions.

• Monitor excess inventory and aging inventory.



Supplier Management

• Coordinate directly with manufacturers in China.

• Obtain production updates and delivery schedules.

• Track purchase orders from placement through delivery.

• Manage supplier communications and maintain vendor relationships.

• Assist with sourcing new products and obtaining quotations.



Freight & Logistics

• Coordinate shipments with freight forwarders.

• Create and manage Amazon FBA shipment plans.

• Track shipments from factory to Amazon fulfillment centers.

• Resolve shipping delays and logistics issues.

• Maintain accurate shipment records.



Amazon Seller Central Operations

• Manage daily Seller Central activities.

• Monitor account health and performance metrics.

• Open and manage support cases with Amazon.

• Resolve stranded inventory and listing issues.

• Monitor suppressed listings and compliance notifications.

• Coordinate product launches and inventory transfers.



Reporting & Analytics

• Prepare weekly KPI reports.

• Monitor:

o Sales performance

o Inventory levels

o Stock coverage

o Advertising performance (high-level)

o Forecast accuracy

• Identify operational risks and growth opportunities.



Process Improvement

• Create and document standard operating procedures.

• Recommend automation tools and workflow improvements.

• Improve forecasting accuracy and operational efficiency.

• Assist management with strategic growth initiatives.



Required Qualifications

Amazon Experience

• Minimum 3 years managing Amazon FBA operations.

• Strong knowledge of Amazon Seller Central.

• Experience with inventory forecasting and replenishment.

• Experience creating FBA shipments.

• Familiarity with Amazon account health requirements.

• Experience operating in multiple Amazon marketplaces preferred.



Supply Chain Experience

• Experience working with Chinese suppliers.

• Experience managing freight forwarders.

• Understanding of international shipping and customs processes.

• Experience with purchase order management.



Technical Skills

• Advanced Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.

• Strong analytical and reporting skills.

• Experience with Amazon software tools preferred.

• Experience with inventory management systems preferred.



Communication Skills

• Excellent written English



• Strong organizational skills.

• Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

• Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

Preferred Qualifications



The ideal candidate has experience with:

• Amazon US, UK, and EU marketplaces

• 1688 sourcing

• Alibaba sourcing

• WeChat supplier communications

• Amazon PPC reporting

• Helium 10

• Sellerboard

• InventoryLab

• SoStocked

• EVA

• Jungle Scout



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Success in this role will be measured by:

• No stockouts on top-selling products

• Accurate inventory forecasting

• On-time shipment execution

• Amazon account health maintained at all times

• Reduced inventory carrying costs

• Improved operational efficiency

• Timely and accurate reporting

title: Inbound Sales Representative (Remote)
description:
Please Read the Whole Job Description Before Applying.



At Meadow, we’re reimagining end-of-life care - a $23B industry untouched by modern software or service thinking. In under a year, we became the largest cremation provider in Los Angeles, with 80+ NPS and hundreds of families served monthly. Now we’re scaling across the U.S. and hiring globally.



We believe great people live everywhere. Our team works across continents and time zones, grounded by shared values: high standards, deep empathy, and a drive to do work that matters.



Learn more about our global teams here: 

If this sounds like your kind of team, we'd love to hear from you.



About the Role

As an Inbound Sales Representative, you’ll be the first voice families hear when they reach out. You’ll guide them with clarity and compassion -  no cold calls or pushy tactics, just meaningful conversations that help people make one of life’s most important decisions with confidence.



This is a sales role: you're responsible for helping families d
 and for closing - always with genuine care, never pressure. Depending on team needs and performance, this role may include a mix of inbound sales conversations, returning lead follow-up, and support work that helps the broader sales process run smoothly. We hire for strong sales potential, and top performers can grow into expanded responsibilities over time..



A quick note, because many candidates wonder about it: People often assume this work is emotionally heavy, but our team consistently finds it deeply meaningful and surprisingly uplifting. The role is rooted in hospitality, clarity, and human connection, not sadness. Rather than feeling heavy, the work offers a unique sense of purpose as part of a modern, compassionate company transforming an outdated industry and bringing dignity, transparency, and warmth to families across the country.



What You’ll Do

- Handle warm inbound leads and support families through the sales process with clarity, empathy, and strong follow-through.

- Guide families through cremation options, helping them make a confident decision when possible and ensuring thoughtful follow-up when more time is needed.

- Manage returning leads and follow-up conversations across phone, text, and
 so no family falls through the cracks.

- Contribute to queue coverage, sales activities, and related support workflows that improve the overall customer experience.

- Hit performance targets while maintaining strong conversion outcomes and quality scores.

- Move fluently across our stack - HubSpot, Aircall, GSuite, Slack, and our case management system.



Requirements

- 2+ years of sales experience with a track record of meeting or exceeding individual targets -  managing the full sales cycle and closing, ideally consumer (B2C) sales over the phone.

- Strong sales instincts and phone presence: you can guide a live conversation toward a confident decision, handle objections naturally, and build trust with families while balancing sales conversations with follow-up and support work.

- Clear spoken and written English; you explain options simply and warmly.

- Self-driven and results-focused: you track where you stand against your target and adjust when you're behind. Emotionally steady and highly coachable

- Comfortable working independently and managing a consistent follow-up rhythm.

- Familiarity with HubSpot or comparable CRMs (Salesforce, Zoho, etc.).

- A home setup that supports the work - see our tech requirements for details..



Bonus Points

- Experience selling in high-trust categories (insurance, healthcare, travel, etc.).

- Spanish fluency -  many of the families we serve speak it.



Details:

- Remote, full-time

- Compensation: $6-$9 USD OTE

- Base rate plus a real, sizable bonus tied to deals closed, conversion performance, and overall team success.

- Targets are designed to be hit, with additional bonus opportunities beyond OTE for top performers.



- Tools: HubSpot (CRM), Aircall (phone), Slack, and our case management system

- Schedule:

- Full-time, 8-hour shifts on a consistent weekly schedule

- Days: Monday–Friday, Tuesday–Saturday, or Sunday–Thursday (weekend availability a plus)

- Available shift windows:

- AM (start 6–8am EST)

- PM (start 1–4pm EST)

- Night (start 8–10pm EST)



Why You’ll Love Working With Us:

- We’re a real business, built to last. We’ve proven our model in LA and became the largest independent funeral home in California in less than two years.  We’re now going national. And plan to grow for years to come.

- A serious employer for global teammates. We have years of experience running distributed teams. Same 1:1s, check-ins, and career paths as our U.S. team - same expectations, same opportunities.

- Growth path: Tea
mbers may begin with a mix of inbound sales, returning lead follow-up, and support responsibilities, with opportunities to take on expanded first-call responsibilities based on performance. 

- People stay. Regrettable turnover is very low. Don't take our word for it - read our Glassdoor reviews.

- Fair compensation with real upside. Base pay benchmarked globally. Top performers consistently earn the full bonuses.

- High care, high standards. Real investment in training and growth, honest feedback, no burnout culture.

- Benefits: PTO, 10 paid holidays, paid training, fully remote.

- Purpose-driven work: Real impact during one of life's most meaningful transitions.



Apply Now

We’re just getting started, and we’re looking for people who want to grow with us. If you’re excited about making an impact, building meaningful relationships, and launching a successful career in sales and tech, apply today. Even if you don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply - your passion and potential matter more than checking every box.



Apply here:

title: Real Estate Photo Editor & QC Specialist
description:
About the Role

Property Pixel is an Australian real estate photography business based in Queensland. We're looking for a skilled photo editor and quality control specialist to join our small remote team on a part-time basis.

Reliable communicator via
