title: Executive Assistant to the CEO
description:
OVERVIEW



Consult Lemonade is seeking a detail-oriented, proactive, and mission-aligned Executive Assistant to directly support the CEO.



This role exists to protect the CEO's capacity for strategic work, including fundraising, partnerships, program expansion, and organizational growth. The Executive Assistant handles the administrative and operational infrastructure that keeps leadership moving efficiently while also serving as a key contributor to grant development and management in partnership with the organization's grant lead.



This is not an entry-level administrative position. We are seeking an experienced Executive Assistant who can confidently support executive leadership, manage competing priorities, exercise sound judgment, and operate independently in a fast-paced environment. While every organization has its own processes and systems, candidates should already possess strong Executive Assistant fundamentals and experience supporting senior leaders.



SCHEDULE



* Part-time position

* Monday through Friday

* 12:00 PM to 4:00 PM EST

* Opportunity for additional hours and expanded responsibilities as the organization grows



LEADING PEOPLE



You do not manage a team, but you represent the CEO's office in every interaction.



Your professionalism, responsiveness, discretion, and follow-through reflect directly on Consult Lemonade's leadership. You will be trusted with sensitive information, key relationships, organizational priorities, and executive communications. This role requires maturity, professionalism, and a high level of integrity.



DELIVERING RESULTS



* CEO calendar is managed proactively with meetings scheduled, conflicts resolved, and preparation materials organized in advance.

* Follow-up items from CEO meetings are tracked, assigned, and completed without requiring the CEO to reinitiate action.

* CEO inbox is actively managed with communications sorted, prioritized, and monitored to ensure timely responses.

* Active partnerships, grants, and community relationships are maintained in a living tracking system with current status updates and next steps documented.

* Organizational priorities are coordinated across teams with the CEO informed and never surprised.

* Grant opportunities are researched and presented to leadership on a regular basis.

* Grant applications, proposals, Letters of Intent (LOIs), one-pagers, and supporting documentation are prepared, submitted, and maintained accurately and on time.

* Grant reporting requirements, compliance deadlines, and supporting records are maintained in an organized, audit-ready system.

* Leverages AI and automation tools appropriately to streamline administrative processes, improve efficiency, and reduce manual workload while maintaining accuracy and quality.

* Administrative burden on leadership is measurably reduced through strong ownership and execution.



COMMUNICATION



* Serve as the first point of contact for the CEO's office, including scheduling requests,
 communications, and external inquiries.

* Own the day-to-day management of the CEO's inbox, including prioritization, organization, drafting responses, and ensuring no communication falls through the cracks.

* Partner closely with the organization's grant lead to support grant writing coordination, deadlines, submissions, and documentation.

* Ensure internal teams receive clear communication regarding CEO priorities, decisions, and expectations.

* Handle sensitive communications with confidentiality and sound judgment.

* Document action items, commitments, and decisions from CEO meetings and ensure appropriate follow-up.



STRATEGIC THINKING



* Understand the CEO's priorities well enough to make informed decisions regarding scheduling, access, and time management.

* Anticipate needs before meetings, events, deadlines, and major initiatives.

* Monitor funding opportunities and trends relevant to Consult Lemonade's mission and programs.

* Identify administrative inefficiencies and recommend practical solutions that improve organizational effectiveness.



ACCOUNTABILITY



* Provide weekly executive briefings that include calendar updates, open action items, grant deadlines, and partnership status reports.

* Ensure no grant deadline or compliance requirement is missed without advance notice and a documented plan.

* Maintain accurate and current records within all tracking and CRM systems.

* Ensure executive communications and follow-up expectations are consistently met.

* Protect CEO capacity by owning responsibilities that should not require executive involvement.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



* Minimum of 3 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Executive Coordinator, Project Coordinator, Administrative Operations Professional, or similar role.

* Demonstrated experience directly supporting senior executives, founders, CEOs, or C-suite leadership.

* Strong executive calendar management and inbox management experience.

* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, projects, and stakeholders simultaneously.

* Experience working in a fast-paced, mission-driven, nonprofit, startup, or growth-oriented environment.

* Strong organizational and project management skills.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

* Experience using project management, collaboration, and CRM systems.

* Comfortable working with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or similar platforms to support research, communication, organization, documentation, and administrative efficiency.

* High degree of discretion, trustworthiness, professionalism, and sound judgment.

* Strong alignment with Consult Lemonade's mission of supporting underrepresented talent in technology.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



* Experience with grant research, grant writing, or nonprofit grant management.

* Familiarity with federal, state, corporate, and foundation funding opportunities.

* Experience coordinating cross-functional projects and organizational initiatives.

* Experience supporting a founder, CEO, or executive leadership team.

* Familiarity with HubSpot, Notion, Asana, Jira, Google Workspace, or similar platforms.



IMMEDIATE HIRE OPPORTUNITY



This is an immediate-hire opportunity for a candidate who can step into the role with confidence and professionalism. We are seeking someone who already understands the fundamentals of executive support and can quickly contribute to the success of the CEO and organization.



HOW TO APPLY



To be considered for this position, applicants must submit all of the following:



1. A current resume that includes complete employment history with start and end dates for each position.



2. A professional portfolio showcasing relevant work, accomplishments, projects, or case studies that demonstrate Executive Assistant, operations, project coordination, executive support, or organizational management experience.



3. A detailed introduction video that includes:



   * Your Executive Assistant experience

   * The executives or leaders you have supported

   * Examples of complex responsibilities you have managed

   * Why you are interested in this opportunity

   * Why you believe you are a strong fit for Consult Lemonade



4. Must use at least 10 apply points to be considered.  



Applications that do not include all three required components will not be reviewed. Attention to detail is a critical part of this role, and complete application submissions are part of the evaluation process.

description:
About the Company



We are a fast-growing beauty brand headquartered in Singapore, with presence in Singapore, Malaysia and Hong Kong, selling via e-commerce and retail (e.g. Watsons). Key Responsibilities



1. Daily / Weekly Bookkeeping

Maintain up-to-date ledgers for:



Bank accounts



Payment gateways (Stripe, PayPal, PayNow, etc.)



E-commerce platforms (Shopify / website, TikTok Shop, Shopee/Lazada if applicable)



Enter and reconcile supplier invoices and payments.

Payment gateways



E-commerce payouts



Marketplace statements (e.g. Watsons, online platforms)



Investigate and resolve discrepancies promptly.

Help create and maintain SOPs for recurring finance tasks.

Strong working knowledge of double-entry bookkeeping and basic accounting principles.



Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud accounting software such as:

Very good Excel / Google Sheets skills (pivot tables, basic formulas, vlookup/index-match).



High attention to detail and accuracy – comfortable handling multi-currency transactions (SGD, MYR, etc.).



Good written and spoken English – clear and professional communication.

Nice-to-Have (Bonus)



Experience working with e-commerce / online businesses (Shopify, WooCommerce, marketplaces, etc.).

Experience preparing management reports for founders/CEOs.



Understanding of basic PH labor / payroll concepts (not mandatory but a plus).

We want somebody who is proactive, fast, organised, and goal-driven — somebody who wants to make as many strong videos as possible every hour while constantly thinking about hooks, duplication strategies, virality, and how content can perform better.



We need somebody who can understand:



Hook psychology

Viral short-form content

Marketing thinking

Social media behaviour

Attention spans

Duplication systems

Speed and consistency

We want somebody who can almost act as a social media marketing manager while editing content — somebody who understands WHY videos perform and constantly comes up with new ideas, hooks, angles, and strategies.



This is a highly rewarding long-term role where your salary and opportunities will grow based on the performance, creativity, speed, and value you bring to the company.



The more we grow, the more we want YOU to grow.



???? If your plan is to clock in, clock out, and do the bare minimum — this is NOT the role for you.

We are only looking for serious growth-minded people who genuinely want to become part of a fast-growing team and contribute long-term.



???? The Workflow (Very Simple Once Understood)

For example:

We may give you one raw footage clip showing a paint colour.



Your job is to:

Add the brand name + colour name

Create a clean simple edit

Duplicate the same video multiple times

Change the colour name in the caption

Change the background footage slightly

Repeat this for every colour variation

For example:

If one brand has 20 colours, you can quickly duplicate the same structure across every colour variation.



Then we repeat the same process again using different hooks and different marketing angles.



This allows us to create large amounts of content quickly and test multiple viral hooks at scale.



The more content we test, the higher the chance we go viral.

For example:



Take 1 raw clip

Add 1 strong hook

Duplicate the same video 20–30 times

Change the colour name

Slightly change footage/background

Export quickly

Repeat with another hook angle

This means in around 30 minutes to 1 hour, you should be capable of producing LARGE amounts of content variations efficiently.



This is NOT about spending hours over-editing one video.



This is about:



Volume

Hooks

Marketing thinking

Speed

Duplication

Testing angles

Viral potential

“This colour trend is going viral for a reason”

“The simplest way to upgrade your home”

We want somebody who constantly thinks:



“What hook would make somebody STOP scrolling?”



???? What You Will Be Responsible For:

Researching powerful hooks and viral caption ideas

Finding and testing video editing AI tools and workflows

Creating and editing social media video responses

Helping brainstorm script ideas and viral content concepts

Duplicating content variations efficiently

Changing backgrounds, hooks, colours, and visual variations quickly

Helping improve workflows and content systems

Supporting the team with social media and marketing tasks when needed

Bringing fresh ideas and marketing angles constantly

We want somebody who thinks:



“How can we make MORE videos, FASTER, while still making them engaging?”



???? Ideal Candidate:

Understands TikTok/Reels editing styles

Fast worker who utilises time effectively

Long-term mindset — not just another editing job

We are looking for somebody who gets excited about helping build something big.

This is a highly incentivised growth role with:

Rapid salary increases

Long-term opportunities inside the company

???? If you bring strong ideas, speed, execution, and results early — you will be rewarded early.

title: Residential Real Estate Legal Assistant for U.S. Law Firm
description:
Job Title: Residential Real Estate Legal Assistant for U.S. Law Firm





Schedule: Part-time. About 20-25 hours per week.



Time Zone: Must be able to overlap with U.S. Central Time



Compensation: Based on experience.



Initial trial period: 60 days at $6/hour.

Compensation may be reviewed after the trial period based on performance, reliability, experience, and fit.



About the Role:



We are a U.S.-based real estate law firm looking for a detail-oriented, organized, and proactive legal assistant to support residential real estate transactions from contract to closing.



This is not a brokerage transaction coordinator role, listing coordinator role, lead management role, cold-calling role, or general real estate VA role.



We are looking for someone who understands real estate transactions and can work in a legal environment, including attorney review, inspection deadlines, title coordination, lender coordination, closing preparation, client communication, document organization, and attorney escalation.



Main Responsibilities:

- Open and set up new real estate matters

- Review contracts and
s to identify key transaction details

- Enter and update client, agent, lender, attorney, and title company contact information

- Track key dates, deadlines, and missing information

- Coordinate with real estate agents, lenders, title companies, opposing counsel, and clients

- Prepare standard documents and
s using templates

- Organize
s, documents, and matter files

- Follow up on missing information or pending items

- Prepare files for attorney review

- Flag unusual, unclear, urgent, or non-standard issues for the attorney

- Support closing preparation and post-closing follow-up

- Maintain task lists and update matter status clearly



Experience We Are Looking For



Strong candidates will have experience with some of the following:

- U.S. residential real estate transactions

- Contract-to-closing coordination

- Buyer-side and/or seller-side transaction support

- Real estate law firm support

- Real estate transaction coordination

- Title company, escrow, mortgage, or brokerage transaction support

- Attorney review process

- Inspection deadlines

- Lender coordination

- Title coordination

- HOA or condo document requests

- Closing preparation

- Closing statements or settlement statements

- Real estate document organization



Experience with Illinois residential real estate transactions is a plus, but not required.



Tools and Systems



Experience with these tools is helpful, but not required:

- Microsoft Outlook

- Microsoft Teams

- Microsoft To Do

- Microsoft SharePoint or OneDrive

- Smokeball, Clio, Odoo, or similar practice management systems

- Adobe Acrobat

- E-signature platforms

- Real estate transaction management systems



You do not need to know every system before starting, but you must be comfortable learning new tools and following detailed SOPs.



This Role Is a Good Fit If You Are:

- Able to think in context, not just complete isolated tasks

- Very organized

- Detail-oriented

- Careful with deadlines

- Comfortable following written instructions and SOPs

- Able to communicate clearly in writing

- Proactive about asking good questions

- Able to notice when something needs attorney review

- Comfortable working with many
s, documents, deadlines, and exceptions

- Reliable, consistent, and accountable

- Calm under pressure

- Interested in long-term work with a small professional team

- Impeccable written and spoken English



This Role Is Not a Good Fit If:

- Your real estate experience is mainly brokerage support, listing coordination, showing coordination, lead generation, CRM updates, social media, cold calling, or agent admin

- You are looking for a general real estate VA role rather than a legal-support role inside a law firm

- You are hoping this role is mostly posting listings, updating CRMs, or making things look nice in Canva

- You have worked around real estate transactions but have not been responsible for contract-to-closing file coordination

- You treat each instruction as a separate task without considering the full status of the matter

- You only have general admin or data entry experience

- You have never worked with U.S. real estate transactions

- Your legal experience is mainly with local court filings, municipal courts, litigation, criminal matters, family law, immigration, or court-based legal work outside the U.S.

- You have general legal experience but no direct experience with U.S. residential real estate transactions

- Your real estate experience is limited to property research, data entry, lead generation, cold calling, or CRM updates

- You need constant reminders about what to do next

- You are uncomfortable reading contracts,
s, and transaction documents

- You are not detail-oriented

- You do not like documenting your work clearly

- You struggle to follow multi-step processes

- You prefer simple repetitive tasks with no judgment involved

- You believe “I did not know” is a good replacement for asking a clear question

- You think this job posting is too long to read carefully



Important Expectation:

> This role requires initiative, context, and judgment.



> The best real estate transaction coordinators do not treat each instruction as an isolated task. They constantly ask: What is the status of this matter, what has already happened, and what needs to happen next without creating confusion, duplication, or risk?



For example, before sending a document, a strong coordinator should think through whether the document is complete, whether it is the correct version, who needs to receive it, whether it has already been sent, whether it is meant for internal or external use, and whether sending it could create a deadline, legal issue, duplicate file, or client confusion.



You will not be expected to provide legal advice. However, you will be expected to understand the context of the matter, notice when something is missing, unusual, unclear, urgent, or outside the normal process, and flag those items for attorney review.



For example, a strong tea
mber should be able to notice when:

- The contract is missing the buyer’s attorney information

- The inspection deadline appears to be tomorrow

- The title company contact is not listed

- The client’s phone number is missing

- A transaction appears to involve a condo or HOA

- An issue should be flagged for attorney review



How to Apply:

Please send your resume, a link to your OnlineJobs.ph profile, and a cover letter answering the questions below to 
 A short summary of your experience with U.S. residential real estate transactions

- Have you supported buyer-side transactions, seller-side transactions, both?

- Describe one U.S. residential real estate transaction you personally supported from contract to closing

- What stages did you handle?

- Who did you coordinate with?

- What documents or deadlines were involved?

- What were you personally responsible for?

- What real estate, legal, title, mortgage, or transaction management tools have you used?

- What is your availability in U.S. Central Time?

- What is your expected hourly rate or monthly salary?



To show that you read the full job post carefully and can follow written instructions, please include the words "blue lagoon" in the subject line of your
.



Applications that do not answer these questions or do not follow the application instructions will not be reviewed.

title: Loan & Investment Specialist
description:
Company: RLW Consulting

Location: Remote

Hours: Full-time (40 hours/week, U.S. business hours - PST, EST, MST, or CST)

Compensation: Base pay only (no additional benefits to start) Healthcare and benefits after one-month trial as contractor

Reports to: Jonetta White | Founder, Principal & CEO



About RLW Consulting

RLW Consulting is a U.S.-based strategy and business development firm that helps organizations identify and secure funding across five key areas: donations, grants, loans, investments, and commercial and government contracts. We provide high-quality consulting, writing, and project management support to nonprofits, small businesses, and entrepreneurs. 

This role sits within our debt and equity fundraising practice, which focuses on developing strong funding strategies across loans, investments, and blended finance opportunities. We create clear, persuasive materials to help clients secure growth capital. Our remote team values professional writing, precise research, and accountability in everything we deliver. 

Our culture values accuracy, independence, professionalism, and accountability.



Position Overview

The Loan & Investment Specialist will support RLW Consulting’s financial proposal work, including preparing investor materials, pitch decks, and loan applications. This role requires a solid understanding of finance, capital access mechanisms, and the ability to communicate complex information clearly and persuasively.



The ideal candidate will also manage their own projects—developing schedules, tracking deliverables, and coordinating inputs across stakeholders. The position may also involve preparing and submitting materials for RLW Consulting’s own fundraising efforts, such as loan, investment, or accelerator applications.



Key Responsibilities

Research loan, credit, and investment programs relevant to client and RLW Consulting projects.

Write and edit financial proposals, loan applications, investment memoranda, and due diligence responses.

Develop pro forma budgets, ROI models, capitalization tables, and basic financial analyses.

Build and maintain reusable content libraries and standardized templates for loan and investment submissions.

Manage your own proposal schedules, set milestones, track deadlines, and ensure on-time submission of deliverables.

Assist with registration profiles and due-diligence questionnaires for lenders, accelerators, and investment platforms.

Demonstrate familiarity with SBA loans, CDFI programs, and investment accelerators such as Y Combinator, Techstars, 500 Global, and MassChallenge.

Demonstrate familiarity with venture capital firms such as Harlem Capital, Backstage Capital, Kapor Capital, and similar impact-focused funds.

Create PowerPoint decks, investor summaries, and financial pitch materials that meet professional standards.

Log opportunities, submissions, and deliverables in Bitrix24 and maintain accurate records of outcomes.

Use AI tools for formatting, data collection, or structure only; final work must be written and edited independently. Research should be gathered from multiple credible sources, including AI, and reviewed and analyzed by a human.



Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, or Business.

5+ years of experience writing financial or investment-related proposals.

Strong analytical and financial modeling skills.

Excellent English writing and communication abilities.

Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.

Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.



Application Requirements

Resume (PDF)

Writing sample (2–3 examples)

Two professional references



Additional Information

This job description is intended to describe the general scope of work and key responsibilities associated with this role. It is not an exhaustive list of all duties, tasks, or qualifications required. RLW Consulting reserves the right to modify, assign, or reassign duties and responsibilities as business needs evolve.

title: Content Strategist
description:
We are looking for a part-time content strategist to work alongside an established video marketing and monetization brand. This is not an entry-level role. We need someone who has done this before, can prove it, and has a clear system for how they work.



About the brand



Keenya Kelly is a video marketing and monetization strategist with a large established audience across TikTok, Instagram, and
. We teach entrepreneurs how to grow through short vertical video and turn their content into consistent income.



We have an active offer ecosystem including a membership, a flagship course, and low-ticket funnels. We are a systems-driven team that operates with clear processes, deadlines, and communication standards.



What we are looking for



You have a proven framework or methodology for creating content that grows accounts AND drives revenue. Not just views.



Not just followers. Actual conversions and sales.



You can show us accounts you have worked on, what the numbers looked like before you got involved, and what happened after. You think in systems. You do not wing it.



You have a repeatable process for researching a brand, building a content strategy, and delivering direction that a team can execute consistently.



You understand the difference between content that builds an audience and content that converts that audience into buyers — and you know how to build both into a strategy at the same time.



What this role involves



?Deep dive into the Keenya Kelly brand — audience, offers, voice, content pillars, and competitors — and develop a content strategy tailored to where we are going, not just where we have been



?Deliver weekly content ideas for Instagram,
, and TikTok — including hooks, format direction, caption angles, and CTAs that connect to our active offers



?Deliver Trial Reels concept per day for Instagram



?Build and hand over a content system our team can run — including a competitor database, hook library, and content direction framework



?Join bi-weekly strategy calls to review performance and align on the next content cycle



?Adapt content direction during active launch periods — we run live challenges, webinars, and course launch campaigns that require content to shift with the offer



What this role does NOT involve



You will not be posting, scheduling, editing videos, designing graphics, managing DMs or comments, or handling any execution. Our team handles all of that. Your job is strategy and content direction only.



You are the right person if



You have a documented system or framework for content strategy — not just experience, an actual repeatable process



You can show us at least two accounts you have grown that also became more profitable — with before and after numbers



You understand short vertical video deeply — TikTok, Instagram Reels, and
 — and you know how to build strategy differently for each platform



You are highly organized and can deliver on deadlines without being chased



You are comfortable working alongside a brand owner who is also a strategist — you do not need to own the entire process

to do your best work



You communicate proactively and do not go silent when things come up



This is not the right role if



You need to control execution in order to stand behind your strategy



You are still building your process and learning as you go



You cannot provide proof of accounts you have grown and monetized



You struggle with structure, deadlines, or communicating your own process clearly



How to apply



Your application must include:



1. A brief description of your content strategy framework or system — how you approach a new brand from day one

We are looking for someone ready to work alongside an established brand, not build one from scratch.

title: Data Entry Assistant – Remote Position for Filipino Applicants
description:
We are a Germany-based company working in the electricity and gas contract sector. We help customers in Germany with the processing and preparation of energy contract documents.



We already work successfully with several Filipino tea
mbers who have been part of our company for years. We are now looking to expand our team and hire additional reliable Filipino workers for long-term remote work.



---



## Job Description



We are looking for a reliable Data Entry Assistant who can help us transfer information from files, tables, and CRM records into prepared letter templates.



You will receive your own CRM access and clear instructions. Your main task will be to take data from spreadsheets and files, enter it correctly into letter templates, and prepare the documents so they can be sent out.



---



## Main Tasks



* Transfer customer data from spreadsheets, files, and CRM records

* Enter information into prepared letter templates

* Prepare letters for sending

* Work with our CRM system

* Check entered data carefully for accuracy

* Follow clear internal processes and instructions

* Document completed tasks properly



---



## Working Hours



*Monday to Friday*

*1:00 PM to 10:00 PM German time*



There will be *1 hours of break time* during the shift.



Effective working time: *8 hours per day*

Weekends are free.



---



## Salary



**1.50 USD per hour**



This is a long-term position with the opportunity to grow together with our company.



---



## Requirements



We are looking for someone who is reliable, accurate, and willing to work long-term.



You should have:



* Good English skills

* Previous Data Entry experience

* Experience with CRM systems or similar software

* Experience working with spreadsheets and digital documents

* High attention to detail

* Reliable and organized working style

* Fast learning ability

* Stable internet connection

* Own computer or laptop

* Valid NBI Clearance or valid identification documents for verification

* Availability to start immediately



---



## What We Offer



* Long-term remote work

* Fixed working hours

* Weekends off

* Clear instructions and structured tasks

* Training through our internal Academy

* Work with a Germany-based company

* Supportive team environment

* Opportunity to grow with us

* Several Filipino tea
mbers already working with us successfully for years



---



## Application Process



Please send us a short application including:



* A short introduction about yourself

* Your previous Data Entry experience

* Your experience with CRM systems

* Your contact details

* Your availability

* Confirmation if you can start immediately



After your first application, you will receive an additional questionnaire. If your answers meet our requirements, you will go through our Academy training.



After the training, we will check whether your work is accurate and reliable. If everything fits, we are looking forward to hiring you for a long-term position.
